scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sarthak/shared && concurrently --kill-others -n shared,api,web "npm run dev -w @sarthak/shared" "npm run dev -w @sarthak/api" "npm run dev -w @sarthak/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sarthak/shared && npm run build -w @sarthak/api && npm run build -w @sarthak/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sarthak/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @sarthak/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.demo: npm run setup:env && npm run build && npm run demo:serve
scripts.demo:serve: concurrently --kill-others -n api,demo "npm run start -w @sarthak/api" "npm run preview -w @sarthak/web"
